reviews.x: Safe and easy to.use. 2 year old twin boys and we used them most recently grocery shopping. The "leash" is a bit long but it was functional. Boys loved their Mickey backpacks and left them on.

reviews.t: It's thin and holds your child pretty good. Love it
reviews.x: My child hates having backpacks on but he loves this harness. It's thin and holds your child pretty good. Love it

Hopefully I will get to update this, but for now it is a 2. I LOVE the backpack itself, but it didn’t come with a “leash” part, and haven’t heard back from the seller yet.  Update: They sent me a new set completely. Wish there had been some communication with saying they'd send me a new one so i didn't go out and buy a leash for the first, but it's all good. Has been working great
Disappointed it said it is a backpack it’s not.

reviews.t: Worked well for us on vacation!
reviews.x: We purchased this harness to use for our 21-month old on our Walt Disney World vacation. We used it when we wanted to give him breaks from the stroller or when we were in lines where we couldn't take the stroller. It is handy that the hand strap detaches from the harness so when we put him back in the stroller, he doesn't have a strap dragging behind or to get tangled up in. Our boy enjoyed the "freedom" this harness gave him all the while giving us the peace of mind knowing he wasn't more than

reviews.t: Mickey was cuter than the monkey!
reviews.x: For a recent Disney World trip, we wanted a Disney-themed harness (instead of the monkey one we already had) so we purchased this one. Not only was it absolutely adorable on our little one, it gave her a lot more freedom to enjoy the park. It was also comfortable enough that she (2 years old) left it on even on rides! It was delivered on time and came in as described.

reviews.t: Great for my twins at Disneyland
reviews.x: We used two of these harnesses for my twins in Disneyland, and they were the best decision we made.  They are two and like to run away and hate to hold hands, so it was nice to be able to give them a bit of freedom without losing track of them.  The harnesses are thin so we didn't need to take them off to go on rides.  Multiple people stopped us and asked where we got them.  (For my daughter I wrapped a little red bow headband around one ear to make it a Minnie harness.)  Some reviewers complain

reviews.t: Best safety device ever for free spirited children
reviews.x: Ever felt trapped as a helicopter parent? You want to let your independent little one walk or run, but the always run too far or too fast and you’re worried someone will take them or they’ll get hurt? This is the perfect middle ground. My little got to run/walk I got to keep him safe and out of harms way. And the fact that it’s Mickey? Oh he was so very excited about that!

This is super cute! It was a little too big for my 16month old to use on our Disneytrip, but she will grow into it. I added a red bow to make it a little more feminine and it looks great. The ears are a little flimsier than I thought they'd be, but they are just fine and don't flop over when worn.

reviews.t: Cute but broken within a few days
reviews.x: Super cute product!! We bought this for a trip to Disney World for our Three-year-old son. We were there for seven days and on the fifth day of use the metal buckle completely broke where the strap attaches to the backpack part so we could not use it anymore for the remaining two days.
We bought this for my nephew. When he wants to go for a walk he will go and get it. We love it.
Worked great for keeping track of my 2 year old at Disney as she likes to run off. Would rebuy
My 3 year old is autistic and has no safety awareness.  This harness is amazing.
I have twin boys who want to run Thur store i love them

reviews.x: I really wanted this to work...it's perfect in quality and cuteness...it's even durable but it smells like strong chemicals. My guess is flame retardant? Its a really strong odor and I'm not an obssesed organic person but I do worry those chemicals will eventually hurt my child in the long run. They we're awesome about the refund! No problems with the company I just have my worries and only for that reason I returned it. Please make this item without any chemicals added and I would love to own i

reviews.t: Made Disneyland that much more magical!
reviews.x: We purchased this product for our almost 2 year old son when we took him to Disneyland and it allowed him to spend time out of his stroller running around the parks and exploring his surroundings which he loved! Everyone kept asking us where we got this and they were shocked when I told them how inexpensive it is. I loved that my little was able to play and explore with freedom and independence and I didn't have to lose my mind worrying about hand holding and chasing him or losing him.

reviews.t: get ready to be stared at
reviews.x: I bought this for my 2 year old for when we went to Disney World she loved it, I loved it and I loved not losing her BUT you will get some people that look at you like a crazy person for putting a "leash" on your kid. But screw them, they wouldn't be the ones to help me if something were to happen and my kid lets go of my hand and runs off to get lost. So definitely  a great buy and it gets the job done.

This is a must to have for active toddlers who want to be independent and walk on their own. I use this for my toddler son on our frequent visits to Disneyworld and have received compliments on it often. I love the fact that he can walk around but still be safe and secure tied to his Mama.

Hard to tell as my lo put backpack on as well but he actually loved it! He would put it on by himself. 3.5 yrs old average (50-60%) for check ups for reference. As I was traveling alone with two kids and my oldest is a runner I needed something to hold on to him with. So glad I got this!

This is a very nice harness! It's way better than the fuzzy ones with animals on them. This one has a longer leash and it's less noticeable to the child wearing it. My daughter likes to wear it and it has kept her with me. We will definitely be taking this to Disney with us this winter!

reviews.t: Great for piece of mind walking throughout Disney (or anywhere ...
reviews.x: Great for piece of mind walking throughout Disney (or anywhere else!). Our 16 month old does not know stranger danger and likes to be 'independent.' Great because I know she will stay close but can still burn off energy by walking in big crowds

I have a big son at 21 months and this fits him with room to grow and peace of mind when we go on walks and he doesn't listen! I've tried others that are super complicated but this just slips over his arms, clips in the front and done!

Worked perfect for us. Took my little one on a Disney cruise and didn't want to take any chances. This harness provided us a lot of stress relief on the boat and islands. Also its pretty good quality so that's a plus. I recommend it!

Child loves to wear this! Product is as described. Mailed as promised, It smelled like a chemical when it arrived. After setting out for 24hrs it was fine. We bought three. The others we washed before use and they smelled good too.

reviews.t: Seller was awesome in correcting a shipping error!
reviews.x: Love this item! I have 4 granddaughters age 2 1/2 and under. I feel so much safer when I am out with them with this safety harness. They have the freedom to walk and explore and I can easily keep track of them.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the harness effective for keeping track of toddlers, especially active children who like to run off, and say it gives them freedom while staying safe.
Reviewers frequently describe the product as cute and well made, with several mentioning Disney-themed trips.
Some reviewers report problems with missing parts or breakage, including a missing leash piece and a buckle that broke after a few days.
A few reviewers note fit or design issues, such as being too big for a 16-month-old or not being a true backpack.
One reviewer complains of a strong chemical smell.
